newsitem.title: GREECE: CAPITAL MARKET COMMS'N FINES TO BENEFIT BOURSE - MIN.
newsitem.headline: CAPITAL MARKET COMMS'N FINES TO BENEFIT BOURSE - MIN.

text.p: The capital market commission's fines on those involved in the Delta Securities scandal which upset the bourse late last year also seek to wipe out insider trading and manipulative practices, the national economy ministry said.
"The aim is not only to punish those responsible but also to wipe out manipulative practices, insider trading and spreading false information," the ministry said in a statement.
It said the Delta Securities affair had entered its final phase with the announcement of fines by the Greek securities watchdog.
"The Athens stock exchange must take the place it deserves among European bourses," it said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
